purpose: GOVERNED prospective canonical 30-question mini fact-check set, frozen against an IMMUTABLE source-bank snapshot. Created under explicit R5 authorization. Prospective only; does NOT retroactively validate A12-R3 or A12-R4.

sourceBank.note: The snapshot is a verbatim byte-for-byte copy of the master bank at freeze time; snapshotSha256 is the SHA-256 of the exact bytes. The selection is reproducible against this frozen snapshot.

selectionMethod.rule: Exclude the reserved cluster/control IDs, sort the remaining eligible IDs ascending by master number, and select the first 30. Independently validated deterministic rule (A12-R4).
selectionMethod.reservedRationale: Q5 = import-VAT/CREATE MORE cluster; Q8 = residential-lease VAT cluster; Q35 & Q41 = citation-relevance clusters; Q28/Q32/Q34/Q46/Q47 = verified-controlling reachability controls. Excluded so the mini fact-check stays independent of the dedicated probe/control sets.

frozenAt: committed and pushed BEFORE any live test execution
